answer: In the Singapore Model AI Governance Framework 2nd Edition, repeatability refers to the ability to consistently perform an action or make a decision within the same organization, given the same scenario. It involves internal repetition of results. On the other hand, reproducibility refers to the ability of an independent verification team to produce the same results using the same AI method based on the documentation provided by the organization. This means that reproducibility involves external verification and can occur under different conditions or by different teams.
